Three sensors are working correctly, but the fourth needs a replacement part that should arrive on Wednesday. Rather than hold the entire shipment, we can return the three working sensors tomorrow at no additional delivery charge. We would then send the remaining one after its final test. You can also ask me for the test reports when you call.

segments.sourceSpokenText: Here is some community news for gardeners. The Maple Street Library is opening a seed exchange cabinet this Monday. You may take up to three small packets per visit, even if you have no seeds to contribute. Each packet includes planting instructions and the name of the plant. The library accepts seed donations only in the original labeled packets. The labels let volunteers check the seed variety and the packing date. If a bag has no markings, we cannot accept the loose seeds inside it. The cabinet will be beside the gardening books, not at the main checkout desk. On opening day, a volunteer will be there from ten until noon to explain how the exchange works. Normal library opening hours apply on other days.

Clean cups will be on the shelf above the sink, and used cups should go into the marked collection tray, not back onto the shelf. Our cleaning team will wash them each evening. However, please leave the cups on this floor so other staff can find them. If the clean supply runs low, notify facilities using the usual online request form.
